narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag now `undefined`, not `false` | Treat missing as off |

The 8 remaining warnings are real noise. They flag old APIs like `Buffer()` and `crypto.createCipher`. Worth clearing before v5, but they do not break the build.
